Free guides and checklists

Take the decision list with you. Free, specific and written by people who have to build what they recommend.

Five guides drawn from Evolve's technical Insights, formatted as PDFs you can hand to your team. Each one ends with the questions to settle before the next commitment, so the next meeting is shorter than the last.

What you are not signing up for

No drip campaign. No weekly newsletter. You get the guide, and at most one short follow-up from an Evolve engineer asking whether it helped and what decision you are working through. Reply once to opt out of everything.

Direct answers

Are these guides written for a specific facility type?

They are written around decisions, not facility types. The site-selection, commissioning and maintenance guides apply to any mission-critical facility. The modular and AI guides are specific to those delivery models and workloads.

Can I read the guides without filling in the form?

Yes. Every guide is also published in full as an Evolve Insight. The PDF is the same content, formatted for printing and sharing.

What happens after I download one?

An Evolve engineer may send one short follow-up. If you want to go further, the project brief on the Start a Project page routes your facility to the right planning, design, construction, power or operations team.
